$comment: No $id on purpose: Test-Json (pwsh 7.6) resolves a relative $ref to a sibling file only when the schema has no absolute $id. The profile files reference the $defs below as ruleset.schema.json#/$defs/<profile>. Every pattern in the Rulebook schemas ends with (?![\s\S]) instead of $: in .NET (Test-Json) $ also matches before a trailing newline, \z is a literal z in ECMA-262 (editors), and the lookahead means end of string in both.
title: Rulebook ruleset file
description: Any ruleset file of an organization rulebook repository: the compiler ruleset schema plus an optional justification per rule. Three profiles: delta (base/, stages/), endpoint (rulesets/) and skeleton (skeletons/). Validate against the profile file of the folder (ruleset.delta.schema.json, ruleset.endpoint.schema.json, ruleset.skeleton.schema.json); this hub accepts a file that matches any profile. See docs/reference/naming.md.

diagnosticId.description: A diagnostic id: two or three capital letters, four digits, an optional lowercase i (PTE0011, AL0432, LC0089i).

ruleAction.description: A rule action. Default is not valid for a rule: the compiler fails to deserialise it.

justification.description: Why the rule has this action. Optional (D37, D40); ignored by the compiler.

deltaRule.description: A rule in a level, stage or skeleton file: id, action and an optional justification.

endpointRule.description: A rule in a generated endpoint: id and action only, never a justification.

include.description: The one include of a skeleton: action Default and the endpoint URL (with {BASEURL} in the template).

delta.description: Delta profile: a level file in base/ or a stage file in stages/. Lists the ids it changes; no includes, no generalAction.

endpoint.description: Endpoint profile: a generated file in rulesets/. The ids whose effective action differs from the catalog default, without justification, no includes, no generalAction.

skeleton.description: Skeleton profile: a file in skeletons/ or a project's .rulebook/. Exactly one include with action Default; own rules allowed (project exceptions); no generalAction.
